author_crosscheck.tool: R 4.5.2 (2025-10-31), base stats only: binom.test, prop.test, poisson.test, qbeta, pbeta, dbinom
author_crosscheck.note: R's binom.test and poisson.test define the two-sided p-value by summing the outcomes no more likely than the observed one (relErr 1 + 1e-7), as scipy.stats.binomtest does; the Clopper-Pearson interval inverts twice the smaller tail
